attributes.name: Pit of Malfeshnekor
attributes.powers:
Draw 3 items from the box. You may choose 1 and add it to your hand; banish any not chosen. If you added 1 to your hand, each character at this location is dealt 1d4+1 Fire damage.

After the encounter, banish the Pit of Malfeshnekor.
